name: The Creepy Carnival

features.name: Star Spin bar
features.description: Stores high-symbol wins for a bonus spin.

review:
The Creepy Carnival is a 5x3 spooky fairground slot. Three or more scatters start free spins that can retrigger up to 50 spins.

Every base-game win on high symbols is stored in the Star Spin bar, which later awards one free spin with extra wilds using those symbols. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 1,595x cap. A gentle game with a dark look.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
